deterministic_intent: Repair the Joyflow semantic-closure candidate so cold-review evidence cannot pass through stale runtime artifacts, substring risk matches, fixture interpretation, incomplete PR diff checks, approval-output ownership confusion, or HARD_STOP closure gaps.

human_semantic_layer.objective: Make Joyflow's three-layer anti-deviation design mechanically honest and ready for a second unfamiliar cold review before any real human acceptance run.
human_semantic_layer.expected_user_result: The package can be safely inspected and installed, but it cannot execute until a real active task supplies authentic reviewed Codex understanding; later evidence cannot silently drift from current source or user meaning.
user_flow: User and Brain close product meaning.
Brain creates the dual-layer contract and fixed acceptance cases.
Reference candidate remains blocked during package review.
A later real ACTIVE_TASK obtains authentic Codex interpretation and Brain alignment.
Codex executes one complete Prompt within allowed writes.
Brain and user separately review the same current evidence bindings.
business_rules: Reference mode cannot execute or close.
Only authentic Codex return reviewed by Brain can release active non-LEAN execution.
Risk words match complete tokens and only intended change surfaces.
PR diff means base-to-head committed changes plus worktree changes.
Codex cannot write Brain or human approval evidence.
All final gates bind current HEAD, Bridge, input bundle, source bundle, task ID, and acceptance plan.
accepted_tradeoffs: The repaired repository candidate intentionally produces a HALT packet until used by a real active task.
The mechanical evidence format becomes slightly larger because it carries binding hashes.
Human acceptance is delayed until a fresh unfamiliar cold review passes.
non_goals: Do not create autonomous agents, enterprise identity systems, automatic merge, automatic deployment, or mechanical product-quality judgment.
Do not claim a standalone v4.3.6 ZIP is frozen before final package build and review.
correct_examples: CI fails if refresh changes a committed deterministic runtime file.
Reference fixture remains non-executable even if its fields are structurally valid.
A committed .github workflow change retains its leading dot and appears in base-to-head diff.
Executor outputs exclude Brain and human receipts.
HARD_STOP remains blocked regardless of later PASS-like fields.
incorrect_examples: Green CI validates a temporarily regenerated Prompt while the repository still stores an old Prompt.
The word product routes to HARD_STOP because prod is a substring.
A fixture with ALIGNED status is treated as a real Codex return.
Reconcile ignores HALT and closes after receipts are edited.

allowed_solution_surfaces: Routing, path, diff, hash, Bridge, Prompt, check, and Reconcile scripts.
Semantic closure specifications and runtime reference artifacts.
Mechanical tests and GitHub Actions workflow.
forbidden_consequences: No active execution from reference mode.
No fixture interpreted as execution evidence.
No Codex write access to Brain or human approvals.
No stale generated runtime accepted by CI.
No clean-worktree substitute for PR diff.
required_outcomes: Reference candidate routes to HARD_STOP and generates HALT.
Active release requires authentic reviewed Codex return or valid LEAN embedding.
Allowed-path checks inspect base-to-head committed diff.
Bridge separates executor, Brain, human, and late machine outputs.
Bridge and Manifest bind authority inputs, source bundle, and full packet inputs.
Reconcile blocks reference, HARD_STOP, non-released, HALT, stale, mismatched, incomplete, or non-human evidence.
allowed_technical_freedom: Equivalent Python organization inside repaired scripts.
Additional narrow assertions and counterexample tests.
Equivalent wording that preserves the confirmed behavior and boundaries.
stop_conditions: Stop if repair would create autonomous execution or replace Brain/user judgment.
Stop if a final PASS cannot be bound to current source and inputs.
Stop before human acceptance if unfamiliar cold review remains blocked.
evidence_requirements: Current Bridge, input bundle, source bundle, HEAD, and PR evidence bindings.

lean_eligibility.basis: This protocol repair changes shared routing, evidence, state, and execution-release rules and is intentionally non-LEAN.

deliverables: Real PR diff and path identity checks.
acceptance_checks: Semantic artifacts parse and task IDs match.
Reference candidate is non-executable and packet is HALT.
product does not match prod and authority does not match auth.
Fixture interpretation cannot release active execution.
Executor outputs exclude Brain and human evidence.
Bridge and packet hashes match every current input.
Refreshing deterministic runtime artifacts leaves no diff.
Reference, HARD_STOP, non-released, and HALT states cannot close.
forbidden: Do not mark this reference candidate executable.
Do not mark user acceptance complete.
Do not claim a frozen standalone v4.3.6 ZIP exists.
forbidden_outcomes: Stale committed Prompt or Bridge with green CI.
Product semantics replaced by machine judgment.
must_not_infer: Do not infer that candidate CI authorizes execution.
Do not infer that an ALIGNED fixture is authentic.
Do not infer that a clean worktree means no PR changes.
Do not infer that every technical difference needs user approval.
human_observation_points: The reference package clearly halts rather than pretending to be executable.
A later real task produces one complete Prompt only after authentic interpretation alignment.
The user never has to approve internal implementation details.
Brain and human evidence remain visibly separate from Codex outputs.
